purpose: Public capability anchors; never evidence of clinical approval or native brachy workflow completion

benchmarks.name: When2Call
benchmarks.why: Explicitly tests calling, asking for missing parameters, answering directly, and admitting lack of usable tools.
benchmarks.limitations: Foreign tool schemas, not BrachyBot UI execution; MCQ log-likelihood scores are not free-generation label accuracy. Judge subset overlaps MCQ and source BFCL.

benchmarks.name: BFCL-v3 (AST/irrelevance/parallel)
benchmarks.why: Function selection, structured arguments, multiple and parallel calls, and not calling irrelevant tools.
benchmarks.limitations: Pinned HF assets are v3, not v4. Static AST subset only; no REST/SQL/foreign stateful executor is claimed. Overlaps When2Call source tasks.

benchmarks.name: MedXpertQA
benchmarks.why: Hard medical reasoning plus actual multimodal medical image questions; reports text and MM separately.
benchmarks.limitations: Knowledge/image capability, not physical-coordinate, dose-engine or surgical-guide evidence; text questions overlap EXT-15 subsets.

benchmarks.name: CMB-Clin
benchmarks.why: Chinese clinical cases with ordered questions; grounded explanation and follow-up interpretation.
benchmarks.limitations: 74 cases, not thousands of independent conversations; general clinical questions, not all brachy. Judge-based clinical answers require independent scorer. CMB-Exam/train excluded from this release.

benchmarks.name: MEDEC-MS
benchmarks.why: Detect and correct errors in clinical text instead of merely answering exam questions; relevant to final-response/report reliability.
benchmarks.limitations: MS test only. UW requires DUA and is not fetched. Not a validator of BrachyBot dose/report-state consistency. Scorer dependency/terms are a separate gate.

benchmarks.name: MedHALT
benchmarks.why: False-confidence, fake questions, none-of-the-above and fabricated reference handling.
benchmarks.limitations: Preserve intentionally misleading candidate input but hide answer labels. Public data licensed; source-code reuse needs license resolution. Not a clinical permission gate.

benchmarks.name: MedRGB
benchmarks.why: Medical evidence sufficiency, noisy retrieved documents, information integration and counterfactual evidence.
benchmarks.limitations: Do not expose signal/noise membership, sub-answers or counterfactual gold. Paper v1 says 3480/four sets; current card says 3680/five. Version-specific counts must be measured. Protocol/scoring certification blocked until original context composition and judge are pinned; no custom score is called original MedRGB.

benchmarks.name: R2MED clinical retrieval
benchmarks.why: Fixed-corpus clinical/treatment retrieval with qrels; assesses whether tools find evidence needed for a medical question.
benchmarks.limitations: Four preselected clinical subsets only, not the full eight-set R2MED aggregate. Give all systems the same corpus. Exclude pre-generated hypothetical documents and other models' results. Do not answer questions from qrels or substitute answer accuracy for retrieval metrics.

benchmarks.name: NFCorpus (BEIR medical retrieval)
benchmarks.why: Medical information retrieval with a small reproducible shared corpus and graded relevance judgments.
benchmarks.limitations: Nutrition/medical search, not brachy-specific guidelines. Use test qrels; all-query count is not test-task count.

assets.name: nfcorpus.zip
assets.version_note: Original BEIR release URL is not versioned; asset SHA256 lock is mandatory.

benchmarks.name: SciFact (BEIR retrieval)
benchmarks.why: Retrieve scientific abstracts supporting/refuting biomedical claims, complementary to clinical answer evaluation.
benchmarks.limitations: This release is retrieval only, not SciFact entailment/rationale scoring. The latter needs the separate official claims/evidence protocol. Never count the two views as independent questions.

assets.name: scifact.zip
assets.version_note: Original BEIR release URL is not versioned; asset SHA256 lock is mandatory.

benchmarks.name: LongHealth
benchmarks.why: Longitudinal clinical documents, negation, chronology, distractors and missing-answer abstention; complements patient conversational memory.
benchmarks.limitations: 20 fictional case clusters/400 questions; task2/3 are repeated views, not 800 fresh questions. Freeze shared distractor/document order and context settings for all systems. Authors ask not to publicly republish examples or train on test data.

benchmarks.name: InjecAgent
benchmarks.why: Untrusted tool/RAG content must not become user authorization or leak case data. A relevant security anchor, not clinical knowledge testing.
benchmarks.limitations: 1054 base scenarios and enhanced repeated views, not 2108 independent tasks. Foreign tools must be mock-only. First-stage public scene is available; native full ASR requires original prompts, parsing and two-stage data-stealing simulator. Upstream utils creates an API client on import and may call a paid simulator: never auto-import it. No original ASR result is manufactured from keyword detection.
